mapper.update: CREATE TABLE ${tableName} ( SEQ NUMBER(11) NOT NULL, AGENT_ID VARCHAR2(50), WATCHDOG_STATUS VARCHAR2(10), WATCHDOG_INTERVAL NUMBER(11), THREAD_LLT VARCHAR2(1000), UPDATE_DATE DATE, ETC VARCHAR2(256) )
CREATE SEQUENCE ${tableName}_SEQ START WITH 1 MAXVALUE 99999999 MINVALUE 1 CYCLE CACHE 20 NOORDER
mapper.select: SELECT AGENT_ID AS agent_id, WATCHDOG_STATUS AS watchdog_status, WATCHDOG_INTERVAL AS watchdog_interval, THREAD_LLT AS thread_loop_time, TO_CHAR(UPDATE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS update_date, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS db_date FROM ${tableName} WHERE WATCHDOG_STATUS = #{watchdogStatus} ORDER BY AGENT_ID

SELECT AGENT_ID AS agent_id, WATCHDOG_STATUS AS watchdog_status, WATCHDOG_INTERVAL AS watchdog_interval, THREAD_LLT AS thread_loop_time, TO_CHAR(UPDATE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS update_date, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS db_date FROM ${tableName} ORDER BY AGENT_ID
SELECT * FROM ${tableName} WHERE AGENT_ID = #{agentId} AND ROWNUM < 2
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${tableName} ( SEQ, AGENT_ID, WATCHDOG_STATUS, WATCHDOG_INTERVAL, UPDATE_DATE, ETC ) VALUES ( ${tableName}_SEQ.nextval, #{agentId}, #{watchdogStatus}, #{watchdogInterval}, SYSDATE, #{monotonicTimestamp} )
